subject: CLAIM c6t-rca-opus #8: cross-attachment framebuffer fetch -> pass-MRT tile job by default (render_encoder.inc tegu_render_pass_mrt_* only; render_pipeline.inc 2 lines in tegu_render_variant_pass_mrt_compile: AIR scope)
body: Plan: reuse lowering-opus's existing pass-MRT path (MULTI_TARGET|TILE_FETCH variant, unwritten targets write_mask 0 = loaded+stored unchanged, batches as true-MRT sidecars), today env-gated off (NORD2_METAL_PASS_MRT=1). New default admission ONLY for a genericMrt (not true-MRT) 2..4-target pipeline whose fragment reads an input attachment other than its main rt (genericFsSubpass & ~main), i.e. exactly air-render-plan's 19/75 that single-RT tile cannot serve; NORD2_METAL_PASS_MRT=1 all (as before), =0 none, unset = cross-fetch only. A refused pass-MRT compile still returns -77 -> today's per-RT memfetch path. render_pipeline.inc: tegu_render_variant_pass_mrt_compile currently compiles with NO AIR scope (same bug air-render-plan fixed for tegu_vf_run) -> under AIR-only it is always refused; I add tegu_render_air_scope(p,genericVs/Fs,genericMeta) around its compile + reset. a34aeb58: OK to touch those 2 lines (~l.1441-1451)? af49a233: I do not touch your l.2628-2652 block. Test: new gpu/tests/pass_mrt_cross_fetch_test.py (CA-harness style, real AIR/frontend/bridge/fake kernel): a 2-attachment pass with corpus a-216 constants, N draws -> one batched JM job, LD_TILE of rt1, rt1 write_mask 0, vs NORD2_METAL_PASS_MRT=0 baseline. Gates after the current HEAVY holder releases.
